## Introduction

In this analysis we explore whether bill length and bill depth differ
across the three islands where the penguins were observed: Torgersen,
Biscoe, and Dream.

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER. Available under a CC0 license.

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
```

## Preparing the data

We load the dataset and remove rows with missing values in the columns
we need.

```{python}
#| label: clean-data

penguins = load_penguins()

penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=["bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "island"])

penguins_clean.head()
```

## Summary statistics by island

We compute the mean and standard deviation of bill length and bill depth
for each island.

```{python}
#| label: summary-stats

island_summary = penguins_clean.groupby("island").agg(
    mean_bill_length=("bill_length_mm", "mean"),
    sd_bill_length=("bill_length_mm", "std"),
    mean_bill_depth=("bill_depth_mm", "mean"),
    sd_bill_depth=("bill_depth_mm", "std"),
    n=("bill_length_mm", "count")
)

island_summary
```

From this table, we can see that bill length and depth vary noticeably
across islands, which is largely explained by the fact that different
penguin species dominate different islands.

## Species counts by island

To understand this further, we look at how many penguins of each species
were observed on each island.

```{python}
#| label: species-by-island

species_island_table = penguins_clean.groupby(["island", "species"]).size().unstack()

species_island_table
```

## Conclusion

Bill length and depth differ across islands mainly because each island is
dominated by a different species. Biscoe is home mostly to Gentoo and
Adelie penguins, while Dream has a mix of Adelie and Chinstrap, and
Torgersen has only Adelie penguins. This explains the differences we see
in the summary statistics above.
